newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin drops 14 cents as London falls.
newsitem.headline: KL tin drops 14 cents as London falls.

text.p: Malaysian tin closed 14 cents lower at 14.50 ringgit ($5.85) a kg due to a weaker close in London last week and an initial high offering, traders said.
Traders said the market saw an opening offer of 100 tonnes against bids of 53 tonnes. Turnover was 95 tonnes against 100 on Friday.

"The market was easier and affected by falls in London," a trader said, adding that prices are likely to stay above 14.50 ringgit. Some buying from Europe, Japan and Malaysia helped sentiment. The local price differential to London rose to $40 a tonne premium from $35 previously.
